question: Should this member-authored draft be accepted as the repository's durable restore-interruption proof after review of its worker-hook and cross-platform test behavior?
rationale: The change affects the reliability evidence used to support persistent SQLite restore safety, and repository policy requires member-authored items to remain open for explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Review and land the proof
options.body: Confirm the two worker barriers match the provider's real publication boundary and land the focused reliability coverage if the harness is deterministic.

options.title: Narrow the harness first
options.body: Ask for a smaller or more directly provider-owned test approach if the filesystem interception proves platform-sensitive or difficult to maintain.

recommendation.title: Review and land the proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the two worker barriers match the provider's real publication boundary and land the focused reliability coverage if the harness is deterministic.
